name: accountUrl
label: Account URL
help: The address you sign in to Spacelift at. For self-hosted Spacelift, use your server's address.

pattern.message: Enter the address only, without a path, e.g. https://myaccount.app.spacelift.io

name: apiKeyId
label: API key ID
help: Create a secret-based API key in Spacelift under **Organization settings > API keys**. See [Spacelift API](https://docs.spacelift.io/integrations/api).

name: apiKeySecret
label: API key secret
help: Shown once, when the key is created. It is also in the file Spacelift downloads at that point.
